input.subject: Duplicate Payment
input.body: Dear Team, I was charged twice while ordering an Xbox Wireless Controller, but only one order was placed successfully. My first payment was made using a different bank account, and I then placed the order successfully using another account. The order ID is BM189438. I would like to request a refund for the first transaction. Please check the duplicate payment and let me know when I can expect the refund.
